name: follower-town
description: A deterministic, streamed WebGL2 town where every follower owns a home.

scripts.demo: node tools/demo-data.mjs data/demo 1000000 && node tools/build.mjs data/demo
scripts.phone: node tools/demo-data.mjs data/small 100000 && node tools/build.mjs data/small /tmp/ft-town-small && node tools/single.mjs /tmp/ft-town-small dist/follower-town.html && node tools/phonetest.cjs dist/follower-town.html
